request:
Create an 8-bit up/down counter module named `updown_counter`.

Ports: `clk` (input), `rst` (input, active-high synchronous reset), `en` (input, 1 bit), `up` (input, 1 bit), `load` (input, 1 bit), `load_val` (input, 8 bits), `count` (output, 8 bits).

Behavior: `count` is a registered output. On reset `count` becomes 0. At every rising clock edge: if `load` is 1, `count` takes `load_val` (load has priority over `en`). Otherwise, if `en` is 1, `count` increments by one when `up` is 1 and decrements by one when `up` is 0, wrapping around modulo 256 (255+1 -> 0, 0-1 -> 255). If neither `load` nor `en` is 1, `count` holds its value. No parameters.
